purpose: Make a deliberate effort or establish a personal practice.
keywords: Dictionary-form / ない-form verb + ようにする.
I make a point of eating vegetables every day.
Please make sure you are not late.
I will try not to look at screens before bed.
formation: Dictionary-form / ない-form verb + ようにする.
restrictions: Often presents an ongoing effort; a single firm decision can use ことにする.
mistake: The expression does not promise perfect success on every occasion.
